activeIndex.zh-CN: 受控使用，当前项的序号（从 0 起）；缺省时最后一项为当前项。
activeIndex.en-US: Controlled index of the current item, counted from 0. The last item is current when omitted.

autoCollapse.zh-CN: 超出 maxItemCount 后是否自动折叠。
autoCollapse.en-US: Whether items beyond maxItemCount collapse automatically.

compact.zh-CN: 是否使用紧凑尺寸，影响图标与文字的尺寸。
compact.en-US: Whether the compact size is used, which sets the size of icons and text.

maxItemCount.zh-CN: 超出多少个级别后自动折叠。
maxItemCount.en-US: Number of levels above which the breadcrumb collapses.

moreType.zh-CN: 内置省略号区域的渲染类型，可选 default、popover；提供 renderMore 时以 renderMore 为准。
moreType.en-US: Built-in rendering of the ellipsis area: default or popover. renderMore wins when it is provided.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击时调用。routes 写法收到该项的路由；Breadcrumb.Item 写法收到 `{ name, href }`，name 是该项的子节点。第二个参数为原生 MouseEvent。传入后没有 href 的项也可以用 Enter 操作。
onClick.en-US: Called on click. With routes it receives the route of the item; with Breadcrumb.Item children it receives `{ name, href }`, where name is the children of the item. The second parameter is the native MouseEvent. Passing it makes items without href operable with Enter as well.

renderItem.zh-CN: 自定义每一项的内容，配合 routes 使用，参数为该项的路由对象（字符串路由为 `{ name }`）。
renderItem.en-US: Renders the content of each item with routes. The parameter is the route object of the item, `{ name }` for a string route.

renderMore.zh-CN: 自定义省略号区域的内容，参数为被折叠的项的数据：routes 写法下是路由对象，children 写法下是各 Breadcrumb.Item 的 props；提供时以它为准。
renderMore.en-US: Custom content of the ellipsis area. The parameter holds the data of the collapsed items: the route objects with routes, or the props of the Breadcrumb.Item children. It wins over moreType when provided.

renderIcon.zh-CN: 自定义 routes 中每一项的图标，参数为该项的路由对象与序号（含被折叠的项）。
renderIcon.en-US: Renders the icon of each item of routes. The parameters are the route object of the item and its index, counting the collapsed items.

routes.zh-CN: 路由信息，由路由对象或字符串组成的数组；不为空时按 routes 渲染，不再渲染 children。
routes.en-US: Route information as an array of route objects or strings. When it is not empty, the items come from it and children are not rendered.

separator.zh-CN: 自定义的分隔符，可以是文字或 JSX 元素。
separator.en-US: Custom separator, either text or a JSX element.

showTooltip.zh-CN: 是否在标题溢出时展示 Tooltip 及相关配置：width 为截断宽度，数字按 px 计算，传 'auto' 时不截断；ellipsisPos 为截断位置，end 或 middle；opts 为传给 Tooltip 的属性，不含 content。传 false 时不展示 Tooltip。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether a Tooltip shows for an overflowing title, with its options: width is the truncation width, a number in px or 'auto' for no truncation; ellipsisPos truncates at the end or in the middle; opts are passed to the Tooltip without content. false hides the Tooltip.

href.zh-CN: 链接的目的地，挂载在 a 标签上；当前项不渲染为链接。
href.en-US: Destination of the link, mounted on an a element. The current item does not render as a link.

icon.zh-CN: 标签的显示图标；Semi 图标未设置 size 时按 Breadcrumb 的 compact 取 small 或 default。
icon.en-US: Icon of the item. A Semi icon without size takes small or default from the compact of Breadcrumb.

noLink.zh-CN: 移除 hover 和 active 的样式，该项也不再可以用键盘操作。
noLink.en-US: Removes the hover and active styles, and the item stops being operable with the keyboard.

onClick.zh-CN: 单击事件，参数同 Breadcrumb 的 onClick：routes 写法为该项的路由，children 写法为 `{ name, href }`；第二个参数为原生 MouseEvent。
onClick.en-US: Click event, with the same parameters as onClick of Breadcrumb: the route of the item with routes, or `{ name, href }` with children. The second parameter is the native MouseEvent.

separator.zh-CN: 该项之后的分隔符，覆盖 Breadcrumb 的 separator，可以是文字或 JSX 元素。
separator.en-US: Separator after this item, overriding the separator of Breadcrumb. It is text or a JSX element.
